hypotheses.construction_plan: Use the two-parameter function template T(a,b). For T(i,j), apply the identity operator and specialize with a=i, b=j. For T(j,i), apply the argument-permutation operator (which maps T(a,b) to T(b,a)) and then specialize with the same a=i, b=j, yielding T(j,i). The observed expression is the sum of these two generated terms.
required_assumptions: T is an undefined two-argument function symbol
i and j are index symbols
permute swaps the two argument positions of T
hypotheses.rationale: Both subexpressions are substitution instances of the same two-parameter template T(a,b) with the index roles either as given or flipped by argument permutation. This matches the observed PERMUTATION_RELATED and SUBSTITUTION_INSTANCE relations without assuming symmetry of T.
